pool.text: A plumber charges a fixed diagnostic fee plus an hourly rate. The total cost for a 2-hour job is $140, and the total cost for a 5-hour job is $275. What is the fixed diagnostic fee in dollars?
pool.educational_aim: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities: apply solving applied ratio, proportion, rate, and percentage problems across multi-step problems (sat linfun 3).
pool.exam_archetype: Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Let the cost function be \( C(h) = rh + F \), where \( r \) is the hourly rate and \( F \) is the fixed fee. The hourly rate is \( r = \dfrac{275 - 140}{5 - 2} = \dfrac{135}{3} = 45 \). Using the 2-hour job: \( 140 = 45(2) + F \implies 140 = 90 + F \implies F = 50 \).
hints: Let the cost function be \( C(h) = rh + F \), where \( r \) is the hourly rate and \( F \) is the fixed fee.
The hourly rate is \(r = \dfrac{275 - 140}{5 - 2} = \dfrac{135}{3}\).
Using the 2-hour job: \(140 = 45(2) + F \implies 140 = 90 + F\).
pool.text_ar: plumber تتقاضى fixed diagnostic رسوم بالإضافة إلى لكل ساعة المعدل. الإجمالي التكلفة لـ a 2-ساعة مهمة يساوي 140 دولار، و الإجمالي التكلفة لـ a 5-ساعة مهمة يساوي 275 دولار. ما fixed diagnostic رسوم في دولار؟
pool.sol_ar: ليكن التكلفة دالة be \(C(h) = rh + F\)، حيث \(r\) يساوي لكل ساعة المعدل و \(F\) يساوي fixed رسوم. لكل ساعة المعدل يساوي \(r = \dfrac{275 - 140}{5 - 2} = \dfrac{135}{3} = 45\). باستخدام 2-ساعة مهمة: \(140 = 45(2) + F \implies 140 = 90 + F \implies F = 50\).
hints_ar: ليكن التكلفة دالة be \(C(h) = rh + F\)، حيث \(r\) يساوي لكل ساعة المعدل و \(F\) يساوي fixed رسوم.

pool.text: What is the area of a circle whose circumference is equal to the perimeter of a square with side length 6?

pool.text: Determine the remainder when the polynomial \(P(x) = 3x^3 + (2)x^2 + (-6)x + (1)\) is divided by \((x + 3)\).

Sum the resulting terms to obtain the remainder.

pool.text: A data set has 10 values with a mean of 15. When a new value \( x \) is added, the new mean becomes 18. What is the value of \( x \)?

pool.exam_archetype: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: Original sum = \( 10 \times 15 = 150 \). New sum with 11 values = \( 11 \times 18 = 198 \). \( x = 198 - 150 = 48 \).
hints: Original sum = \( 10 \times 15 = 150 \).
New sum with 11 values = \( 11 \times 18 = 198 \).
Use the resulting form to finish: \(x = 198 - 150\).
pool.text_ar: بيانات مجموعة له 10 قيم مع المتوسط الحسابي من 15. عندما جديد قيمة \(x\) يساوي أُضيف، جديد المتوسط الحسابي يصبح 18. ما قيمة \(x\)؟
pool.sol_ar: الأصلية مجموع = \(10 \times 15 = 150\). جديد مجموع مع 11 قيم = \(11 \times 18 = 198\). \(x = 198 - 150 = 48\).

pool.text: If \( 2^{x+y} = 128 \) and \( 2^{x-y} = 8 \), what is the value of \( xy \)?
pool.educational_aim: Connect Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions concepts to solve standard-difficulty exam problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Write both right sides as powers of 2: \( 128 = 2^7 \) and \( 8 = 2^3 \). This gives the linear system: \( x + y = 7 \) and \( x - y = 3 \). Add the equations: \( 2x = 10 \implies x = 5 \). Subtract the equations: \( 2y = 4 \implies y = 2 \). Thus \( xy = 5 \times 2 = 10 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(2^{x+y} = 128\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \(2^{x+y} = 128\) and \(2^{x-y} = 8\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(2^{x+y} = 128\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(2^{x+y} = 128\) و \(2^{x-y} = 8\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.sol_ar: اكتب كلا قائم الطرفين كـ القوى من 2: \(128 = 2^7\) و \(8 = 2^3\). هذا يعطي الخطية نظام: \(x + y = 7\) و \(x - y = 3\). اجمع معادلات: \(2x = 10 \implies x = 5\). اطرح معادلات: \(2y = 4 \implies y = 2\). وعليه \(xy = 5 \times 2 = 10\).

pool.text:
In the system of equations:
\[ \begin{cases} 4x + 6y = 15 \\ 2x + ky = 7.5 \end{cases} \]

pool.sol: Multiplying the second equation by 2 gives \( 4x + 2ky = 15 \). For this to match \( 4x + 6y = 15 \), \( 2k = 6 \implies k = 3 \).

\[\begin{cases} 4x + 6y = 15 \\ 2x + ky = 7.5 \end{cases}\]

pool.sol_ar: بضرب الثاني معادلة بواسطة 2 يعطي \(4x + 2ky = 15\). لـ هذا إلى يطابق \(4x + 6y = 15\)، \(2k = 6 \implies k = 3\).

pool.text: For the linear function \( f(x) = ax + b \), the graph of \( y = f(x) \) has a \( y \)-intercept of \( (0, 3) \), and the graph of \( y = f(x + 2) \) has a \( y \)-intercept of \( (0, 11) \). What is the value of the constant \( a \)?
pool.educational_aim: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities: apply determining slopes, intercepts, and linear equations across multi-step problems (sat linfun 1).
pool.exam_archetype: Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: Since the \( y \)-intercept of \( f \) is 3, \( b = 3 \). Now \( f(x + 2) = a(x + 2) + 3 = ax + 2a + 3 \). The \( y \)-intercept of \( f(x+2) \) is \( 2a + 3 \). Given \( 2a + 3 = 11 \Rightarrow 2a = 8 \Rightarrow a = 4 \).
hints: Since the \( y \)-intercept of \( f \) is 3, \( b = 3 \).
Now \( f(x + 2) = a(x + 2) + 3 = ax + 2a + 3 \). The \( y \)-intercept of \( f(x+2) \) is \( 2a + 3 \).
Given \(2a + 3 = 11 \implies 2a = 8\).
pool.text_ar: لـ الخطية دالة \(f(x) = ax + b\)، التمثيل البياني لـ \(y = f(x)\) له a المقطع على محور \(y\) من \((0, 3)\)، و التمثيل البياني لـ \(y = f(x + 2)\) له a المقطع على محور \(y\) من \((0, 11)\). ما قيمة ثابت \(a\)؟
pool.sol_ar: بما أن \(y\)-المقطع من \(f\) يساوي 3, \(b = 3\). Now \(f(x + 2) = a(x + 2) + 3 = ax + 2a + 3\). \(y\)-المقطع من \(f(x+2)\) يساوي \(2a + 3\). المعطى \(2a + 3 = 11 \Rightarrow 2a = 8 \Rightarrow a = 4\).

pool.text: The point \( (4, 14) \) lies on the line \( y = kx - 2 \) in the \( xy \)-plane, where \( k \) is a constant. What is the value of \( k \)?

hints: Concept & Formula (Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(y = kx - 2\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \(y = kx - 2\) and \(xy\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.

تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(y = kx - 2\) و \(xy\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: نقطة \((4, 14)\) يقع على مستقيم \(y = kx - 2\) في \(xy\)-المستوى، حيث \(k\) يساوي ثابت. ما قيمة \(k\)؟
pool.sol_ar: عوّض \(x = 4\) و \(y = 14\): \(14 = 4k - 2 \Rightarrow 4k = 16 \Rightarrow k = 4\).

pool.text: A password consists of 3 distinct digits chosen from 1 through 9. What is the probability that the password starts with an odd digit and ends with an even digit?
pool.educational_aim: Connect Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables concepts to solve standard-difficulty exam problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Odd digits: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 (5 choices). Even digits: 2, 4, 6, 8 (4 choices). Total passwords of 3 distinct digits = \( 9 \times 8 \times 7 = 504 \). Favorable passwords: 5 choices for 1st, 4 choices for 3rd, and \( 9 - 2 = 7 \) choices for middle digit: \( 5 \times 7 \times 4 = 140 \). Probability = \( 140 / 504 = 5 / 18 \).
hints: Odd digits: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 (5 choices).

Even digits: 2, 4, 6, 8 (4 choices). Total passwords of 3 distinct digits = \( 9 \times 8 \times 7 = 504 \). Favorable passwords: 5 choices for 1st, 4 choices for 3rd, and \( 9 - 2 = 7 \) choices for middle digit: \( 5 \times 7 \times 4 = 140 \).
Probability = \(140 / 504\).
pool.text_ar: password consists من 3 مختلفة خانات المختار من 1 خلال 9. ما احتمال أن password starts مع فردي خانة و ends مع زوجي خانة؟
pool.sol_ar: فردي خانات: 1، 3، 5، 7، 9 (5 خيارات). زوجي خانات: 2، 4، 6، 8 (4 خيارات). الإجمالي passwords من 3 مختلفة خانات = \(9 \times 8 \times 7 = 504\). مواتٍ passwords: 5 خيارات لـ 1st، 4 خيارات لـ 3rd، و \(9 - 2 = 7\) خيارات لـ أوسط خانة: \(5 \times 7 \times 4 = 140\). احتمال = \(140 / 504 = 5 / 18\).
hints_ar: زوجي خانات: 2، 4، 6، 8 (4 خيارات). الإجمالي passwords من 3 مختلفة خانات = \(9 \times 8 \times 7 = 504\). مواتٍ passwords: 5 خيارات لـ 1st، 4 خيارات لـ 3rd، و \(9 - 2 = 7\) خيارات لـ أوسط خانة: \(5 \times 7 \times 4 = 140\).

pool.text: When \( (x+4)(x+1) \) is expanded, what is the coefficient of \( x \)?
pool.educational_aim: Apply core Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions principles to solve foundational problems accurately.
pool.exam_archetype: Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions — Core Procedural Application
pool.sol: \( (x+4)(x+1)=x^2+5x+4 \), so the coefficient of \( x \) is \( 5 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \((x+4)(x+1)\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \((x+4)(x+1)\) and \(x\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \((x+4)(x+1)\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \((x+4)(x+1)\) و \(x\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: عندما \((x+4)(x+1)\) يساوي expanded، ما معامل من \(x\)؟
pool.sol_ar: \((x+4)(x+1)=x^2+5x+4\)، لذلك معامل من \(x\) يساوي \(5\).

pool.text: Two geometrically similar solids have corresponding linear dimensions in the ratio \(3 : 5\). The smaller solid has a total surface area of \(45\) square centimeters. Find the exact numerical value of the total surface area (in square centimeters) of the larger solid.
pool.sol: Scaling linear dimensions by \(\frac{5}{3}\) scales total surface area by \(\left(\frac{5}{3}\right)^{2} = \frac{25}{9}\), giving \(45 \cdot \frac{25}{9} = 125\).
hints: For similar figures with linear scale ratio \(p : q\), areas scale as \(p^2 : q^2\) and volumes scale as \(p^3 : q^3\).
Compute the scaling factor \(\left(\frac{5}{3}\right)^{2}\).
Multiply \(45\) by that factor.
pool.text_ar: مجسمان متشابهان هندسياً نسبة التشابه الخطي بين أبعادهما المتناظرة \(3 : 5\). إذا كان المساحة السطحية الكلية لـ المجسم الأصغر يساوي \(45\) سم مربع، أوجد القيمة العددية الدقيقة للمقدار total surface area (in square centimeters) of larger solid.
pool.sol_ar: مضاعفة الأبعاد الخطية بالعامل \(\frac{5}{3}\) تضاعف المساحة السطحية بالعامل \(\left(\frac{5}{3}\right)^{2} = \frac{25}{9}\)، فينتج \(45 \cdot \frac{25}{9} = 125\).

pool.sol: By exponent rules, \( f(a + b) = 3^{a+b} = 3^a \cdot 3^b = f(a) \cdot f(b) \). Thus \( 72 = 8 \cdot f(b) \implies f(b) = 9 \).

pool.text: If \( x > 0 \) and \( x^4 - 13x^2 + 36 = 0 \), what is the largest possible value of \( x \)?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on SAT past papers.
pool.exam_archetype: One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: Let \( u = x^2 \). Then the equation becomes \( u^2 - 13u + 36 = 0 \). Factor: \( (u - 9)(u - 4) = 0 \implies u = 9 \) or \( u = 4 \). Since \( u = x^2 \), we have \( x^2 = 9 \implies x = \pm 3 \), and \( x^2 = 4 \implies x = \pm 2 \). The largest positive value of \( x \) is 3.
hints: Concept & Formula (Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(x > 0\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \(x > 0\) and \(x^4 - 13x^2 + 36 = 0\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(x > 0\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(x > 0\) و \(x^4 - 13x^2 + 36 = 0\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: إذا كان \(x > 0\) و \(x^4 - 13x^2 + 36 = 0\)، ما الأكبر ممكن قيمة من \(x\)؟
pool.sol_ar: ليكن \(u = x^2\). ثم معادلة يصبح \(u^2 - 13u + 36 = 0\). حلّل: \((u - 9)(u - 4) = 0 \implies u = 9\) أو \(u = 4\). بما أن \(u = x^2\)، we لدينا \(x^2 = 9 \implies x = \pm 3\)، و \(x^2 = 4 \implies x = \pm 2\). الأكبر موجب قيمة من \(x\) يساوي 3.

الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.

pool.text: How many real solutions does the equation \( |2x - 6| = x - 5 \) have?
pool.educational_aim: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equation: apply modeling and solving linear or nonlinear inequalities across multi-step problems (sat linea.
pool.exam_archetype: Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: The absolute value \( |2x - 6| \geq 0 \) for all real \( x \). For \( x - 5 \geq 0 \implies x \geq 5 \). Case 1: \( 2x - 6 = x - 5 \implies x = 1 \) (not \( \geq 5 \)). Case 2: \( 2x - 6 = -(x - 5) = -x + 5 \implies 3x = 11 \implies x = 11/3 < 5 \). Neither candidate satisfies \( x \geq 5 \), so there are 0 real solutions.
hints: Concept & Formula (Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(|2x - 6| = x - 5\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: rewrite \(|2x - 6| = x - 5\) in standard algebraic form and isolate the unknown expression on one side.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(|2x - 6| = x - 5\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: أعد كتابة \(|2x - 6| = x - 5\) بالصورة الجبرية القياسية واعزل المقدار المجهول في طرف مستقل.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: كم عدد حقيقي حلول هل معادلة \(|2x - 6| = x - 5\) لدينا؟
pool.sol_ar: absolute قيمة \(|2x - 6| \geq 0\) لكل حقيقي \(x\). لـ \(x - 5 \geq 0 \implies x \geq 5\). حالة 1: \(2x - 6 = x - 5 \implies x = 1\) (ليس \(\geq 5\)). حالة 2: \(2x - 6 = -(x - 5) = -x + 5 \implies 3x = 11 \implies x = 11/3 < 5\). لا هذا ولا ذاك candidate يحقق \(x \geq 5\)، لذلك يوجد 0 حقيقي حلول.

pool.text: A parabola has its vertex at \( (3, -4) \) and passes through \( (5, 8) \). What is the value of \( y \) when \( x = 1 \)?

pool.sol: Vertex form: \( y = a(x - 3)^2 - 4 \). Substitute \( (5, 8) \): \( 8 = a(5 - 3)^2 - 4 \implies 8 = 4a - 4 \implies 4a = 12 \implies a = 3 \). By symmetry across \( x = 3 \), the value at \( x = 1 \) is the same as at \( x = 5 \), which is 8.
hints: Concept & Formula (Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \((3, -4)\) to the requested unknown.

تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \((3, -4)\) و \(y\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.

pool.sol_ar: رأس الصيغة: \(y = a(x - 3)^2 - 4\). عوّض \((5, 8)\): \(8 = a(5 - 3)^2 - 4 \implies 8 = 4a - 4 \implies 4a = 12 \implies a = 3\). بواسطة التماثل عبر \(x = 3\)، قيمة عند \(x = 1\) يساوي نفس كـ عند \(x = 5\)، التي يساوي 8.

pool.sol: Arc length formula: \( s = \dfrac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times 2\pi r = \dfrac{60}{360} \times 2\pi(12) = \dfrac{1}{6} \times 24\pi = 4\pi \). Dividing by \( \pi \) yields 4.

pool.text: Line \( L \) in the \( xy \)-plane passes through \( (3, 8) \) and is perpendicular to the line with equation \( y = -\dfrac{1}{4}x + 2 \). What is the \( y \)-intercept of line \( L \)?
pool.educational_aim: Apply core Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities principles to solve foundational problems accurately.
pool.exam_archetype: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities — Core Procedural Application
pool.sol: Perpendicular lines have negative reciprocal slopes. The negative reciprocal of \( -\dfrac{1}{4} \) is 4, so line \( L \) has slope \( m = 4 \). Using point-slope form with \( (3, 8) \): \( y - 8 = 4(x - 3) \implies y - 8 = 4x - 12 \implies y = 4x - 4 \). Thus the \( y \)-intercept is \( -4 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(L\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \(L\) and \(xy\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.

تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(L\) و \(xy\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.

pool.sol_ar: العمودي مستقيمات لدينا سالب مقلوب ميول. سالب مقلوب من \(-\dfrac{1}{4}\) يساوي 4، لذلك مستقيم \(L\) له ميل \(m = 4\). باستخدام نقطة-ميل الصيغة مع \((3, 8)\): \(y - 8 = 4(x - 3) \implies y - 8 = 4x - 12 \implies y = 4x - 4\). وعليه المقطع على محور \(y\) يساوي \(-4\).

pool.text: For what value of the constant \(k\) is the line \(y = -2\) tangent to the parabola \(y = 4x^2 + (-16)x + k\) in the \(xy\)-plane?
pool.sol: Tangency means \(4x^2 + (-16)x + (k - (-2)) = 0\) has exactly one real root, so its discriminant is zero: \((-16)^2 - 4(4)(k - (-2)) = 0 \Rightarrow 256 = 16(k - (-2)) \Rightarrow k = 14\).
hints: Set \(4x^2 + (-16)x + k = -2\) and move all terms to one side.

Solve the resulting linear equation for \(k\).
pool.text_ar: ما قيمة الثابت \(k\) التي تجعل المستقيم \(y = -2\) مماساً للقطع المكافئ \(y = 4x^2 + (-16)x + k\) في المستوى الإحداثي \(xy\)؟
pool.sol_ar: شرط التماس هو أن يكون للمعادلة \(4x^2 + (-16)x + (k - (-2)) = 0\) جذر حقيقي واحد، أي \((-16)^2 - 4(4)(k - (-2)) = 0 \Rightarrow 256 = 16(k - (-2)) \Rightarrow k = 14\).

pool.text: If \( |x - 2| + |x - 8| = 6 \), which interval contains all solutions for \( x \)?

pool.sol: \( |x - 2| + |x - 8| \) represents the sum of distances from \( x \) to 2 and from \( x \) to 8. The distance between 2 and 8 is exactly 6. By the triangle inequality, this sum equals 6 for every point in the closed interval \( [2, 8] \).

pool.text: What is the solution to \( \dfrac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3} = 2x - 1 \)?
pool.educational_aim: Synthesize Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions with related mathematical concepts to solve high-difficulty past-paper synthesis, optimization, proof, or modeling problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: For \( x \neq 3 \), \( \dfrac{(x - 3)(x + 3)}{x - 3} = x + 3 \). Set \( x + 3 = 2x - 1 \implies x = 4 \). Since \( 4 \neq 3 \), the solution is valid.
hints: Concept & Formula (Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(\dfrac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3} = 2x - 1\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: rewrite \(\dfrac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3} = 2x - 1\) in standard algebraic form and isolate the unknown expression on one side.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(\dfrac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3} = 2x - 1\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: أعد كتابة \(\dfrac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3} = 2x - 1\) بالصورة الجبرية القياسية واعزل المقدار المجهول في طرف مستقل.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: ما حل إلى \(\dfrac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3} = 2x - 1\)؟
pool.sol_ar: لـ \(x \neq 3\)، \(\dfrac{(x - 3)(x + 3)}{x - 3} = x + 3\). مجموعة \(x + 3 = 2x - 1 \implies x = 4\). بما أن \(4 \neq 3\)، حل يساوي صحيح.

pool.text: In the \(xy\)-plane, line \(\ell\) is defined by \(4x - 3y = -5\). Line \(k\) is perpendicular to line \(\ell\) and passes through the point \((-4, 2)\). Calculate the \(y\)-coordinate of the \(y\)-intercept of line \(k\).
pool.sol: Rewriting \(4x - 3y = -5\) in slope-intercept form gives \(y = \frac{4}{3}x - \frac{-5}{3}\), so line \(\ell\) has slope \(\frac{4}{3}\). The perpendicular line \(k\) has negative reciprocal slope \(m_k = -\frac{3}{4}\). Using \((-4, 2)\): \(b_k = 2 - \left(-\frac{3}{4}\right)(-4) = 2 + (3)(-1) = -1\).
hints: Solve \(4x - 3y = -5\) for \(y\) to identify the slope of line \(\ell\).
Take the negative reciprocal of line \(\ell\)'s slope to get the slope of perpendicular line \(k\).
Substitute \((-4, 2)\) into \(y = m_k x + b\) and solve for \(b\).
pool.text_ar: في المستوى الإحداثي \(xy\)، يُعرّف المستقيم \(\ell\) بالمعادلة \(4x - 3y = -5\). إذا كان المستقيم \(k\) عمودياً على \(\ell\) ويمر بالنقطة \((-4, 2)\)، فاحسب الإحداثي \(y\) للمقطع الصادي \(y\) للمستقيم \(k\).
pool.sol_ar: كتابة \(4x - 3y = -5\) بصيغة الميل والمقطع تعطي \(y = \frac{4}{3}x - \frac{-5}{3}\)، فيكون ميل \(\ell\) هو \(\frac{4}{3}\). وميل العمودي \(k\) هو \(m_k = -\frac{3}{4}\). وباستعمال \((-4, 2)\) نجد \(b_k = 2 - \left(-\frac{3}{4}\right)(-4) = 2 + (3)(-1) = -1\).
hints_ar: أعد كتابة \(4x - 3y = -5\) بدلالة \(y\) لإيجاد ميل المستقيم \(\ell\).

عوّض النقطة \((-4, 2)\) في المعادلة \(y = m_k x + b\) لإيجاد \(b\).

pool.text: For what value of \( k \) will the lines \( 3x - ky = 12 \) and \( 2x + 6y = 15 \) be perpendicular?
pool.educational_aim: Apply core Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations principles to solve foundational problems accurately.
pool.exam_archetype: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations — Core Procedural Application
pool.sol: Slope of second line: \( 2x + 6y = 15 \implies y = -\dfrac{1}{3}x + 2.5 \implies m_2 = -\dfrac{1}{3} \). The perpendicular slope is \( m_1 = 3 \). First line: \( ky = 3x - 12 \implies m_1 = \dfrac{3}{k} \). Set \( \dfrac{3}{k} = 3 \implies k = 1 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(k\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \(k\) and \(3x - ky = 12\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(k\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(k\) و \(3x - ky = 12\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: لأي قيمة لـ \(k\) سوف مستقيمات \(3x - ky = 12\) و \(2x + 6y = 15\) be العمودي؟
pool.sol_ar: الميل من الثاني المستقيم: \(2x + 6y = 15 \implies y = -\dfrac{1}{3}x + 2.5 \implies m_2 = -\dfrac{1}{3}\). العمودي الميل يساوي \(m_1 = 3\). الأول المستقيم: \(ky = 3x - 12 \implies m_1 = \dfrac{3}{k}\). مجموعة \(\dfrac{3}{k} = 3 \implies k = 1\).

pool.text: Which expression is equivalent to \( x^{1/3} \) for \( x \geq 0 \)?

الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.

pool.sol_ar: بواسطة تعريف من نسبي الأسس, \(x^{1/n} = \sqrt[n]{x}\). وعليه \(x^{1/3} = \sqrt[3]{x}\).

pool.text: In the \( xy \)-plane, the line \( y = mx + 4 \) intersects the line \( y = 2x - 6 \) at a point on the \( x \)-axis. What is the value of \( m \)?

pool.text: If \( \sqrt{2x + 15} - x = 0 \), what is the sum of all valid real solutions?
pool.educational_aim: Apply properties and theorems of Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations in multi-step exam problems, including finding unknown parameters, interpreting exact diagrams/graphs, and avoiding common algebraic traps.
pool.exam_archetype: Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: \( \sqrt{2x + 15} = x \). Square both sides: \( 2x + 15 = x^2 \implies x^2 - 2x - 15 = 0 \implies (x - 5)(x + 3) = 0 \). At \( x = -3 \): \( \sqrt{9} = 3 \neq -3 \) (extraneous). At \( x = 5 \): \( \sqrt{25} = 5 \) (valid). The only valid solution is 5.
hints: Concept & Formula (Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(\sqrt{2x + 15} - x = 0\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: rewrite \(\sqrt{2x + 15} - x = 0\) in standard algebraic form and isolate the unknown expression on one side.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(\sqrt{2x + 15} - x = 0\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: أعد كتابة \(\sqrt{2x + 15} - x = 0\) بالصورة الجبرية القياسية واعزل المقدار المجهول في طرف مستقل.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: إذا كان \(\sqrt{2x + 15} - x = 0\)، ما مجموع من جميع صحيح حقيقي حلول؟
pool.sol_ar: \(\sqrt{2x + 15} = x\). المربع كلا الطرفين: \(2x + 15 = x^2 \implies x^2 - 2x - 15 = 0 \implies (x - 5)(x + 3) = 0\). عند \(x = -3\): \(\sqrt{9} = 3 \neq -3\) (دخيل). عند \(x = 5\): \(\sqrt{25} = 5\) (صحيح). فقط صحيح حل يساوي 5.

pool.text: A line passes through \( (-2, k) \), \( (4, 11) \), and \( (8, 19) \). What is the value of \( k \)?

pool.text: If a price is increased by \( x\% \) and then decreased by \( x\% \), the final price is \( \$384 \). If the original price was \( \$400 \), what is the value of \( x \)?

pool.text:
In the system of equations below, \( k \) is a constant:
\[ \begin{cases} 3x - 5y = 12 \\ 6x + ky = 7 \end{cases} \]
If the system has no solution, what is the value of \( k \)?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on SAT past papers.
pool.exam_archetype: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: For a linear system to have no solution, the lines must be parallel (same slope) with different y-intercepts. The ratio of coefficients of x and y must be equal: \( \dfrac{6}{3} = \dfrac{k}{-5} \implies 2 = \dfrac{k}{-5} \implies k = -10 \). Since \( 7/12 \neq 2 \), there are no solutions.
hints: For a linear system to have no solution, the lines must be parallel (same slope) with different y-intercepts.
The ratio of coefficients of x and y must be equal: \(\dfrac{6}{3} = \dfrac{k}{-5} \implies 2 = \dfrac{k}{-5} \implies k\).
Since \(7/12 \neq 2\), there are no solutions.
pool.text_ar:
في نظام المعادلات أدناه، \(k\) يساوي ثابت:
\[\begin{cases} 3x - 5y = 12 \\ 6x + ky = 7 \end{cases}\]
إذا كان نظام له لا يوجد حل، ما قيمة \(k\)؟
pool.sol_ar: لـ الخطية نظام إلى لدينا لا يوجد حل، مستقيمات يجب أن يكون الموازي (نفس ميل) مع مختلف y-المقاطع. النسبة من المعاملات من x و y يجب أن يكون متساوي: \(\dfrac{6}{3} = \dfrac{k}{-5} \implies 2 = \dfrac{k}{-5} \implies k = -10\). بما أن \(7/12 \neq 2\)، يوجد لا حلول.
hints_ar: لـ الخطية نظام إلى لدينا لا يوجد حل، مستقيمات يجب أن يكون الموازي (نفس ميل) مع مختلف y-المقاطع.
النسبة من المعاملات من x و y يجب أن يكون متساوي: \(\dfrac{6}{3} = \dfrac{k}{-5} \implies 2 = \dfrac{k}{-5} \implies k\).

pool.text: A rectangle is inscribed in a circle of radius 10. If the length of the rectangle is 16, what is the area of the rectangle?

pool.sol: The diagonal of the inscribed rectangle is a diameter of the circle: \( d = 2(10) = 20 \). By the Pythagorean theorem, the width \( w = \sqrt{20^2 - 16^2} = \sqrt{400 - 256} = \sqrt{144} = 12 \). The area is \( 16 \times 12 = 192 \).
hints: The diagonal of the inscribed rectangle is a diameter of the circle: \(d = 2(10)\).

pool.text: The line \( y = kx + 7 \) intersects the line \( y = -2x + 1 \) at a point with a positive \( x \)-coordinate and a positive \( y \)-coordinate. Which condition must \( k \) satisfy?
pool.educational_aim: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities: apply modeling and solving linear or nonlinear inequalities across multi-step problems (sat linfun 3).
pool.exam_archetype: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Set \( kx + 7 = -2x + 1 \implies (k + 2)x = -6 \implies x = -\dfrac{6}{k + 2} \). For \( x > 0 \), we must have \( k + 2 < 0 \implies k < -2 \). Then \( y = -2\left(-\dfrac{6}{k+2}\right) + 1 = \dfrac{12}{k+2} + 1 = \dfrac{k + 14}{k + 2} \). For \( y > 0 \) when \( k + 2 < 0 \), the numerator \( k + 14 \) must also be negative: \( k + 14 < 0 \implies k < -14 \).
hints: Set \( kx + 7 = -2x + 1 \implies (k + 2)x = -6 \implies x = -\dfrac{6}{k + 2} \).
For \( x > 0 \), we must have \( k + 2 < 0 \implies k < -2 \). Then \( y = -2\left(-\dfrac{6}{k+2}\right) + 1 = \dfrac{12}{k+2} + 1 = \dfrac{k + 14}{k + 2} \).
For \(y > 0\) when \(k + 2 < 0\), the numerator \(k + 14\) must also be negative: \(k + 14 < 0\).
pool.text_ar: مستقيم \(y = kx + 7\) يقطع مستقيم \(y = -2x + 1\) عند نقطة مع موجب إحداثي \(x\) و موجب إحداثي \(y\). التي الشرط يجب \(k\) يحقق؟
pool.sol_ar: مجموعة \(kx + 7 = -2x + 1 \implies (k + 2)x = -6 \implies x = -\dfrac{6}{k + 2}\). لـ \(x > 0\)، we يجب لدينا \(k + 2 < 0 \implies k < -2\). ثم \(y = -2\left(-\dfrac{6}{k+2}\right) + 1 = \dfrac{12}{k+2} + 1 = \dfrac{k + 14}{k + 2}\). لـ \(y > 0\) عندما \(k + 2 < 0\)، البسط \(k + 14\) يجب أيضًا be سالب: \(k + 14 < 0 \implies k < -14\).
hints_ar: لـ \(x > 0\)، we يجب لدينا \(k + 2 < 0 \implies k < -2\). ثم \(y = -2\left(-\dfrac{6}{k+2}\right) + 1 = \dfrac{12}{k+2} + 1 = \dfrac{k + 14}{k + 2}\).
لـ \(y > 0\) عندما \(k + 2 < 0\)، البسط \(k + 14\) يجب أيضًا be سالب: \(k + 14 < 0\).

pool.text: A circle in the coordinate plane passes through \( (0, 0) \), \( (8, 0) \), and \( (0, 6) \). What is the radius of the circle?

pool.sol: The triangle with vertices \( (0, 6) \), \( (0, 0) \), and \( (8, 0) \) is a right triangle with right angle at the origin. By Thales's Theorem, the hypotenuse connecting \( (0, 6) \) and \( (8, 0) \) is a diameter of the circle. Diameter \( d = \sqrt{8^2 + 6^2} = 10 \). Thus radius \( r = 5 \).

pool.text: If \( a \) and \( b \) are the solutions to \( x^2 - 7x + 5 = 0 \), what is the value of \( a^2 + b^2 \)?

pool.sol: By Vieta's formulas, \( a + b = 7 \) and \( ab = 5 \). Using the algebraic identity \( (a + b)^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2 \), we can isolate \( a^2 + b^2 \): \( a^2 + b^2 = (a + b)^2 - 2ab = (7)^2 - 2(5) = 49 - 10 = 39 \).

pool.sol_ar: بواسطة فييتا's القوانين، \(a + b = 7\) و \(ab = 5\). باستخدام الجبري متطابقة \((a + b)^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2\)، we يمكن اعزل \(a^2 + b^2\): \(a^2 + b^2 = (a + b)^2 - 2ab = (7)^2 - 2(5) = 49 - 10 = 39\).

pool.text: Line \( k \) passes through the points \( (7,2) \) and \( (-3,22) \). Line \( p \) is perpendicular to line \( k \) and passes through \( (4,-3) \). What is the \( y \)-intercept of line \( p \)?
pool.educational_aim: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities: apply determining slopes, intercepts, and linear equations across multi-step problems (sat linfun 1).
pool.exam_archetype: Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: The slope of line \( k \) is \( m_1 = \frac{22-2}{-3-7} = \frac{20}{-10} = -2 \). Because line \( p \) is perpendicular to line \( k \), its slope is the negative reciprocal: \( m_2 = \frac{1}{2} \). Using point-slope form with \( (4, -3) \): \( y - (-3) = \frac{1}{2}(x - 4) \Rightarrow y + 3 = \frac{1}{2}x - 2 \Rightarrow y = \frac{1}{2}x - 5 \). Therefore, the \( y \)-intercept of line \( p \) is \( -5 \).
hints: The slope of line \( k \) is \(m_1 = \frac{22-2}{-3-7} = \frac{20}{-10}\).

Because line \( p \) is perpendicular to line \( k \), its slope is the negative reciprocal: \( m_2 = \frac{1}{2} \). Using point-slope form with \( (4, -3) \): \( y - (-3) = \frac{1}{2}(x - 4) \Rightarrow y + 3 = \frac{1}{2}x - 2 \Rightarrow y = \frac{1}{2}x - 5 \).
Verify your final answer by substituting back into the original relationship.

hints_ar: لأن مستقيم \(p\) يساوي عمودي على مستقيم \(k\)، له ميل يساوي سالب مقلوب: \(m_2 = \frac{1}{2}\). باستخدام نقطة-ميل الصيغة مع \((4, -3)\): \(y - (-3) = \frac{1}{2}(x - 4) \Rightarrow y + 3 = \frac{1}{2}x - 2 \Rightarrow y = \frac{1}{2}x - 5\).

pool.text: In the system \( \dfrac{1}{2}x - \dfrac{1}{3}y = 4 \) and \( \dfrac{1}{4}x + \dfrac{1}{6}y = 5 \), what is the value of \( x \)?

pool.text: If \( \begin{cases} ax + by = 12 \\ 4a + 3b = 16 \end{cases} \) and \( x = 2, y = 3 \), what is the value of \( a \)?
pool.educational_aim: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equation: apply core concepts and algebraic reasoning to standard exam items (sat linear 1).
pool.exam_archetype: Nonlinear Functions & Function Notation — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: Substitute \( x = 2, y = 3 \) into the first equation: \( 2a + 3b = 12 \). Subtract this from \( 4a + 3b = 16 \): \( (4a + 3b) - (2a + 3b) = 16 - 12 \implies 2a = 4 \implies a = 2 \).

Equation Setup: combine \(\begin{cases} ax + by = 12 \\ 4a + 3b = 16 \end{cases}\) and \(a\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(\begin{cases} ax + by = 12 \\ 4a + 3b = 16 \end{cases}\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(\begin{cases} ax + by = 12 \\ 4a + 3b = 16 \end{cases}\) و \(a\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: إذا كان \(\begin{cases} ax + by = 12 \\ 4a + 3b = 16 \end{cases}\) و \(x = 2, y = 3\), ما قيمة \(a\)?
pool.sol_ar: عوّض \(x = 2, y = 3\) إلى الأول معادلة: \(2a + 3b = 12\). اطرح هذا من \(4a + 3b = 16\): \((4a + 3b) - (2a + 3b) = 16 - 12 \implies 2a = 4 \implies a = 2\).

pool.text: In the \( xy \)-plane, line \( L_1 \) has the equation \( 3x - 4y = 12 \). Line \( L_2 \) is perpendicular to \( L_1 \) and passes through the point \( (6, -1) \). What is the \( y \)-intercept of line \( L_2 \)?
pool.educational_aim: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities: apply determining slopes, intercepts, and linear equations across multi-step problems (sat linfun 3).
pool.exam_archetype: Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Rewrite \( L_1 \): \( y = \frac{3}{4}x - 3 \). The slope of \( L_1 \) is \( \frac{3}{4} \), so the perpendicular slope of \( L_2 \) is \( -\frac{4}{3} \). Using point-slope form with \( (6,-1) \): \( y - (-1) = -\frac{4}{3}(x - 6) \Rightarrow y = -\frac{4}{3}x + 8 - 1 = -\frac{4}{3}x + 7 \). The \( y \)-intercept is \( 7 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(xy\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \(xy\) and \(L_1\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(xy\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(xy\) و \(L_1\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: في \(xy\)-المستوى، مستقيم \(L_1\) له معادلة \(3x - 4y = 12\). مستقيم \(L_2\) يساوي عمودي على \(L_1\) و يمر بالنقطة \((6, -1)\). ما المقطع على محور \(y\) من مستقيم \(L_2\)؟
pool.sol_ar: أعد كتابة \(L_1\): \(y = \frac{3}{4}x - 3\). ميل من \(L_1\) يساوي \(\frac{3}{4}\)، لذلك العمودي ميل من \(L_2\) يساوي \(-\frac{4}{3}\). باستخدام نقطة-ميل الصيغة مع \((6,-1)\): \(y - (-1) = -\frac{4}{3}(x - 6) \Rightarrow y = -\frac{4}{3}x + 8 - 1 = -\frac{4}{3}x + 7\). المقطع على محور \(y\) يساوي \(7\).

pool.text: If \( f(x) = 2^x + 3 \), what is the \( y \)-intercept of the graph of \( f \)?

pool.text: Convert a flow rate of 120 gallons per minute to cubic feet per second. (1 cubic foot \( \approx 7.48 \) gallons)

In cubic feet: \(2 / 7.48\). Rewrite and substitute: \(2 / 7.48 = 0.267\).
Verify your final answer by substituting back into the original relationship.

pool.sol_ar: جالونات لكل الثاني = \(120 / 60 = 2 \text{ gal/s}\). في تكعيبي أقدام: \(2 / 7.48 \approx 0.267 \approx 0.27 \text{ ft}^3/\text{s}\).
hints_ar: في تكعيبي أقدام: \(2 / 7.48\). أعد كتابة و عوّض: \(2 / 7.48 = 0.267\).

pool.text: A school drama club sells student tickets for \( \$6 \) each and adult tickets for \( \$10 \) each. The auditorium can seat at most \( 250 \) people, and the club must raise at least \( \$1,800 \) from ticket sales to cover production costs. If \( s \) represents the number of student tickets and \( a \) represents the number of adult tickets sold, which system of inequalities represents this situation?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of Desmos Graphing Calculator Tactics by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on SAT past papers.
pool.exam_archetype: Desmos Graphing Calculator Tactics — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: The total number of tickets cannot exceed 250: \( s + a \le 250 \). The total revenue from tickets must be at least $1,800: \( 6s + 10a \ge 1800 \).
hints: The total number of tickets cannot exceed 250: \( s + a \le 250 \).
The total revenue from tickets must be at least $1,800: \(6s + 10a \ge 1800\).
Verify your final answer by substituting back into the original relationship.
pool.text_ar: مدرسة drama نادي يبيع طالب تذاكر لـ \(\$6\) كل و بالغ تذاكر لـ \(\$10\) كل. auditorium يمكن seat على الأكثر \(250\) أشخاص، و نادي يجب raise على الأقل \(\$1,800\) من تذكرة sales إلى cover production costs. إذا كان \(s\) يمثل عدد من طالب تذاكر و \(a\) يمثل عدد من بالغ تذاكر مبيع، التي نظام من المتباينات يمثل هذا situation؟

pool.exam_archetype: Desmos Graphing Calculator Tactics — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: In vertex form \( y = a(x - h)^2 + k \), the coordinates of the vertex are \( (h, k) \). Here \( h = 4 \) and \( k = 9 \), so the \( y \)-coordinate is 9.
hints: Concept & Formula (Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(y\) to the requested unknown.

pool.text_ar: بفرض أن أن \(f(x)=5\cdot 2^{x}\)، ما يساوي \(f(4)\)؟

أعد كتابة المقدار \((r_1 - r_2)^2\) بدلالة مجموع الجذرين وحاصل ضربهما.

pool.text: Function \( f \) is defined by \( f(x) = a \cdot b^x \). If \( f(0) = 6 \) and \( f(2) = 54 \), with \( b > 0 \), what is the value of \( b \)?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on SAT past papers.
pool.exam_archetype: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: From \( f(0) = 6 \), we have \( a \cdot b^0 = a \cdot 1 = 6 \implies a = 6 \). Then \( f(2) = 6 \cdot b^2 = 54 \implies b^2 = 9 \). Since \( b > 0 \), \( b = 3 \).
hints: From \( f(0) = 6 \), we have \(a \cdot b^0 = a \cdot 1 = 6 \implies a\).
Then \(f(2) = 6 \cdot b^2 = 54 \implies b^2\).
pool.text_ar: دالة \(f\) يساوي معرّفة بالعلاقة \(f(x) = a \cdot b^x\). إذا كان \(f(0) = 6\) و \(f(2) = 54\)، مع \(b > 0\)، ما قيمة \(b\)؟
pool.sol_ar: من \(f(0) = 6\)، we لدينا \(a \cdot b^0 = a \cdot 1 = 6 \implies a = 6\). ثم \(f(2) = 6 \cdot b^2 = 54 \implies b^2 = 9\). بما أن \(b > 0\)، \(b = 3\).
hints_ar: من \(f(0) = 6\)، we لدينا \(a \cdot b^0 = a \cdot 1 = 6 \implies a\).

pool.text: The graph of the linear equation \( y = (k - 3)x + 7 \) is parallel to the graph of \( 8x - 2y = 15 \) in the \( xy \)-plane, where \( k \) is a constant. What is the value of \( k \)?
pool.educational_aim: Apply core Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities principles to solve foundational problems accurately.
pool.exam_archetype: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities — Core Procedural Application
pool.sol: Rewrite \( 8x - 2y = 15 \) as \( y = 4x - \frac{15}{2} \). Parallel lines have equal slopes, so \( k - 3 = 4 \Rightarrow k = 7 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(8x - 2y = 15\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \(8x - 2y = 15\) and \(xy\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(8x - 2y = 15\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(8x - 2y = 15\) و \(xy\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: التمثيل البياني لـ الخطية معادلة \(y = (k - 3)x + 7\) يساوي موازٍ لـ التمثيل البياني لـ \(8x - 2y = 15\) في \(xy\)-المستوى، حيث \(k\) يساوي ثابت. ما قيمة \(k\)؟
pool.sol_ar: أعد كتابة \(8x - 2y = 15\) كـ \(y = 4x - \frac{15}{2}\). الموازي مستقيمات لدينا متساوي ميول، لذلك \(k - 3 = 4 \Rightarrow k = 7\).

pool.text: The graph of \( f(x) = 3x - 5 \) in the \( xy \)-plane is shifted upward by \( 4 \) units and to the right by \( 2 \) units to produce the graph of \( g(x) \). Which equation defines \( g(x) \)?
pool.educational_aim: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities: apply core concepts and algebraic reasoning to standard exam items (sat linfun 3).
pool.exam_archetype: Nonlinear Functions & Function Notation — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: Shift up 4: \( f(x) + 4 = 3x - 1 \). Shift right 2: replace \( x \) with \( x - 2 \): \( 3(x - 2) - 1 = 3x - 6 - 1 = 3x - 7 \).
hints: Shift up 4: \( f(x) + 4 = 3x - 1 \).
Shift right 2: replace \( x \) with \( x - 2 \): \(3(x - 2) - 1\). Rewrite and substitute: \(3(x - 2) - 1 = 3x - 6 - 1\).
Verify your final answer by substituting back into the original relationship.
pool.text_ar: التمثيل البياني لـ \(f(x) = 3x - 5\) في \(xy\)-المستوى يساوي مُزاح upward بواسطة \(4\) وحدات و إلى قائم بواسطة \(2\) وحدات إلى تنتج التمثيل البياني لـ \(g(x)\). التي معادلة يعرّف \(g(x)\)؟
pool.sol_ar: إزاحة أعلى 4: \(f(x) + 4 = 3x - 1\). إزاحة قائم 2: replace \(x\) مع \(x - 2\): \(3(x - 2) - 1 = 3x - 6 - 1 = 3x - 7\).
hints_ar: إزاحة قائم 2: replace \(x\) مع \(x - 2\): \(3(x - 2) - 1\). أعد كتابة و عوّض: \(3(x - 2) - 1 = 3x - 6 - 1\).
تحقق من الخاص بك النهائي الإجابة بواسطة بالتعويض مرة أخرى إلى الأصلية العلاقة.

pool.text: Which expression is equivalent to \( x^{4}\cdot x^{7} \)?

pool.sol: Applying Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions principles, \( x^{4}\cdot x^{7}=x^{4+7}=x^{11} \) Therefore, the verified correct option is \( x^{11} \).

pool.sol_ar: بتطبيق دوال أسية، الجذور، كثيرات الحدود & نسبي عبارات المبادئ، \(x^{4}\cdot x^{7}=x^{4+7}=x^{11}\) إذن، متحقق منه الصحيحة الخيار يساوي \(x^{11}\).
hints_ar: بتطبيق دوال أسية، الجذور، كثيرات الحدود & نسبي عبارات المبادئ،: \(x^{4}\cdot x^{7}\).
أعد كتابة و عوّض: \(x^{4}\cdot x^{7} = x^{4+7}\).
تحقق من الخاص بك النهائي الإجابة بواسطة بالتعويض مرة أخرى إلى الأصلية العلاقة.

pool.text: The line \( y = 2x + k \) is tangent to the circle \( x^2 + y^2 = 5 \). What is a possible value of \( k \)?

pool.sol: Distance from center \( (0, 0) \) to line \( 2x - y + k = 0 \) must equal the radius \( \sqrt{5} \): \( d = \dfrac{|k|}{\sqrt{2^2 + (-1)^2}} = \dfrac{|k|}{\sqrt{5}} = \sqrt{5} \implies |k| = 5 \). Thus \( k = \pm 5 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(y = 2x + k\) to the requested unknown.

Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (المساحة, الحجم, المثلثات, الدوائر & حساب المثلثات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(y = 2x + k\) بالمجهول المطلوب.

pool.text_ar: مستقيم \(y = 2x + k\) يساوي مماس إلى دائرة \(x^2 + y^2 = 5\). ما يساوي ممكن قيمة من \(k\)؟
pool.sol_ar: المسافة من المركز \((0, 0)\) إلى مستقيم \(2x - y + k = 0\) يجب متساوي نصف القطر \(\sqrt{5}\): \(d = \dfrac{|k|}{\sqrt{2^2 + (-1)^2}} = \dfrac{|k|}{\sqrt{5}} = \sqrt{5} \implies |k| = 5\). وعليه \(k = \pm 5\).

pool.text: What is the extraneous solution to the radical equation \( \sqrt{x + 18} = x - 2 \)?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on SAT past papers.

pool.sol: Square both sides: \( x + 18 = x^2 - 4x + 4 \implies x^2 - 5x - 14 = 0 \implies (x - 7)(x + 2) = 0 \). At \( x = 7 \), \( \sqrt{25} = 5 = 7 - 2 \) (valid). At \( x = -2 \), \( \sqrt{16} = 4 \neq -4 \) (extraneous). The extraneous solution is \( -2 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(\sqrt{x + 18} = x - 2\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: rewrite \(\sqrt{x + 18} = x - 2\) in standard algebraic form and isolate the unknown expression on one side.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(\sqrt{x + 18} = x - 2\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: أعد كتابة \(\sqrt{x + 18} = x - 2\) بالصورة الجبرية القياسية واعزل المقدار المجهول في طرف مستقل.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: ما دخيل حل إلى الجذر معادلة \(\sqrt{x + 18} = x - 2\)؟
pool.sol_ar: المربع كلا الطرفين: \(x + 18 = x^2 - 4x + 4 \implies x^2 - 5x - 14 = 0 \implies (x - 7)(x + 2) = 0\). عند \(x = 7\)، \(\sqrt{25} = 5 = 7 - 2\) (صحيح). عند \(x = -2\)، \(\sqrt{16} = 4 \neq -4\) (دخيل). دخيل حل يساوي \(-2\).

pool.text: A bacterial culture starts with \(400\) cells and increases by \(50\%\) every \(6\) hours. Calculate how many cells are in the culture after \(12\) hours.
pool.sol: Over \(12\) hours there are \(\frac{12}{6} = 2\) growth intervals, each multiplying by \(1 + \frac{50}{100} = \frac{3}{2}\). Thus \(N(12) = 400\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)^{2} = 900\).
hints: Determine how many full growth or decay intervals occur during the total elapsed time.
Write the exponential model \(N(t) = N_0 \cdot r^k\), where \(k\) is the number of intervals.
Raise the multiplier \(r\) to the power \(k\) and multiply by the initial quantity.
pool.text_ar: تبدأ مزرعة بكتيرية بعدد \(400\) خلية وتزداد بنسبة \(50\%\) كل \(6\) ساعات. احسب كم عدد الخلايا في المزرعة بعد \(12\) ساعة.
pool.sol_ar: خلال \(12\) ساعة توجد \(\frac{12}{6} = 2\) فترات نمو، ومعامل النمو هو \(1 + \frac{50}{100} = \frac{3}{2}\)، ومنه \(N(12) = 400\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)^{2} = 900\).
hints_ar: حدد عدد فترات النمو أو الاضمحلال الكاملة خلال الزمن الكلي المعطى.
اكتب النموذج الأسي \(N(t) = N_0 \cdot r^k\) حيث \(k\) عدد الفترات.
احسب \(r^k\) ثم اضرب الناتج في القيمة الابتدائية.

pool.text: For what value of \( a \) does the parabola \( y = ax^2 + 4x - 1 \) have its maximum value equal to 3?
pool.educational_aim: Connect Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations concepts to solve standard-difficulty exam problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: For a maximum, \( a < 0 \). The vertex occurs at \( x = -\dfrac{4}{2a} = -\dfrac{2}{a} \). Substitute: \( y = a\left(-\dfrac{2}{a}\right)^2 + 4\left(-\dfrac{2}{a}\right) - 1 = \dfrac{4}{a} - \dfrac{8}{a} - 1 = -\dfrac{4}{a} - 1 \). Set \( -\dfrac{4}{a} - 1 = 3 \implies -\dfrac{4}{a} = 4 \implies a = -1 \).
hints: For a maximum, \( a < 0 \).

The vertex occurs at \( x = -\dfrac{4}{2a} = -\dfrac{2}{a} \). Substitute: \( y = a\left(-\dfrac{2}{a}\right)^2 + 4\left(-\dfrac{2}{a}\right) - 1 = \dfrac{4}{a} - \dfrac{8}{a} - 1 = -\dfrac{4}{a} - 1 \).
Verify your final answer by substituting back into the original relationship.
pool.text_ar: لأي قيمة لـ \(a\) هل قطع مكافئ \(y = ax^2 + 4x - 1\) لدينا له القيمة العظمى قيمة متساوي إلى 3؟
pool.sol_ar: لـ القيمة العظمى، \(a < 0\). رأس يحدث عند \(x = -\dfrac{4}{2a} = -\dfrac{2}{a}\). عوّض: \(y = a\left(-\dfrac{2}{a}\right)^2 + 4\left(-\dfrac{2}{a}\right) - 1 = \dfrac{4}{a} - \dfrac{8}{a} - 1 = -\dfrac{4}{a} - 1\). مجموعة \(-\dfrac{4}{a} - 1 = 3 \implies -\dfrac{4}{a} = 4 \implies a = -1\).
hints_ar: تحقق من الخاص بك النهائي الإجابة بواسطة بالتعويض مرة أخرى إلى الأصلية العلاقة.

pool.text: For what value of \( c \) is \( x + 3 \) a factor of \( 2x^3 + 5x^2 - 4x + c \)?
pool.educational_aim: Connect Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions concepts to solve standard-difficulty exam problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: By the Factor Theorem, evaluating at \( x = -3 \) must give 0: \( 2(-27) + 5(9) - 4(-3) + c = 0 \implies -54 + 45 + 12 + c = 0 \implies 3 + c = 0 \implies c = -3 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(c\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \(c\) and \(x + 3\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(c\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(c\) و \(x + 3\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: لأي قيمة لـ \(c\) يساوي \(x + 3\) حلّل من \(2x^3 + 5x^2 - 4x + c\)؟
pool.sol_ar: بواسطة حلّل نظرية، بحساب عند \(x = -3\) يجب يعطي 0: \(2(-27) + 5(9) - 4(-3) + c = 0 \implies -54 + 45 + 12 + c = 0 \implies 3 + c = 0 \implies c = -3\).

pool.text: Suppose \(8^{x + (-5)} = 2^{5x + (-21)}\) for a real number \(x\). Find \(x\).
hints: Express \(8\) as a power of the common base \(2\).
Use the power-of-a-power rule \((b^p)^u = b^{pu}\) and equate the two exponents.
Solve the resulting linear equation for \(x\).
pool.text_ar: إذا كان \(8^{x + (-5)} = 2^{5x + (-21)}\) حيث \(x\) عدد حقيقي، أوجد \(x\).
pool.sol_ar: بكتابة \(8 = 2^{3}\) نحصل على \(2^{3(x + (-5))} = 2^{5x + (-21)}\). وبمساواة الأسس نجد \(3x + (-15) = 5x + (-21) \Rightarrow (-2)x = -6 \Rightarrow x = 3\).
hints_ar: طبّق قاعدة قوة القوة \((b^p)^u = b^{pu}\) ثم ساوِ الأسين.

pool.sol: Find vertices: \( y = 2x \) meets \( x \)-axis at \( (0, 0) \). \( y = -\dfrac{1}{2}x + 10 \) meets \( x \)-axis at \( (20, 0) \). Base along the x-axis has length 20. pool.text: In the \( xy \)-plane, what is the area of the triangular region bounded by the lines \( y = \frac{1}{2}x \), \( y = -2x + 10 \), and the \( x \)-axis?
pool.educational_aim: Connect Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities concepts to solve standard-difficulty exam problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: The line \( y = \frac{1}{2}x \) crosses the \( x \)-axis at \( (0,0) \). The line \( y = -2x + 10 \) crosses the \( x \)-axis at \( (5,0) \). The base along the \( x \)-axis has length \( 5 - 0 = 5 \). Finding the intersection: \( \frac{1}{2}x = -2x + 10 \Rightarrow 2.5x = 10 \Rightarrow x = 4 \), so \( y = 2 \). The height is \( 2 \). Area \( = \frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height} = \frac{1}{2} \times 5 \times 2 = 5 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(xy\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \(xy\) and \(y = \frac{1}{2}x\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(xy\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(xy\) و \(y = \frac{1}{2}x\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: في \(xy\)-المستوى، ما مساحة من triangular منطقة المحصور بالمستقيمات \(y = \frac{1}{2}x\)، \(y = -2x + 10\)، و محور \(x\)؟
pool.sol_ar: مستقيم \(y = \frac{1}{2}x\) crosses محور \(x\) عند \((0,0)\). مستقيم \(y = -2x + 10\) crosses محور \(x\) عند \((5,0)\). القاعدة على طول محور \(x\) له الطول \(5 - 0 = 5\). Finding تقاطع: \(\frac{1}{2}x = -2x + 10 \Rightarrow 2.5x = 10 \Rightarrow x = 4\)، لذلك \(y = 2\). الارتفاع يساوي \(2\). مساحة \(= \frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height} = \frac{1}{2} \times 5 \times 2 = 5\).

pool.text: In the \( xy \)-plane, the points \( (1, 3) \) and \( (7, 11) \) are the endpoints of a diameter of a circle. What is the equation of the tangent line to the circle at the point \( (7, 11) \)?

pool.sol: Center is \( \left(\frac{1+7}{2}, \frac{3+11}{2}\right) = (4, 7) \). Slope of radial segment from center to \( (7, 11) \) is \( \frac{11 - 7}{7 - 4} = \frac{4}{3} \). The tangent line is perpendicular to the radius, so its slope is \( -\frac{3}{4} \). Using point \( (7, 11) \): \( y - 11 = -\frac{3}{4}(x - 7) \Rightarrow 4y - 44 = -3x + 21 \Rightarrow 3x + 4y = 65 \).

pool.text: What is the sum of the solutions to \( |x - 4| = 2x - 5 \)?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on SAT past papers.
pool.exam_archetype: One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: Case 1: \( x - 4 = 2x - 5 \implies x = 1 \). Check in original: \( |1 - 4| = 3 \), right side \( 2(1) - 5 = -3 \neq 3 \), so \( x = 1 \) is extraneous! Case 2: \( x - 4 = -(2x - 5) = -2x + 5 \implies 3x = 9 \implies x = 3 \). Check: \( |3 - 4| = 1 \), right side \( 2(3) - 5 = 1 \). Valid! Only solution is \( x = 3 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(|x - 4| = 2x - 5\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: rewrite \(|x - 4| = 2x - 5\) in standard algebraic form and isolate the unknown expression on one side.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(|x - 4| = 2x - 5\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: أعد كتابة \(|x - 4| = 2x - 5\) بالصورة الجبرية القياسية واعزل المقدار المجهول في طرف مستقل.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: ما مجموع من حلول إلى \(|x - 4| = 2x - 5\)؟
pool.sol_ar: حالة 1: \(x - 4 = 2x - 5 \implies x = 1\). تحقق في الأصلية: \(|1 - 4| = 3\)، قائم الضلع \(2(1) - 5 = -3 \neq 3\)، لذلك \(x = 1\) يساوي دخيل! حالة 2: \(x - 4 = -(2x - 5) = -2x + 5 \implies 3x = 9 \implies x = 3\). تحقق: \(|3 - 4| = 1\)، قائم الضلع \(2(3) - 5 = 1\). صحيح! فقط حل يساوي \(x = 3\).

pool.text: A data set has 10 values with a mean of 25. If each value in the data set is multiplied by 3 and then increased by 4, what is the new mean of the data set?

pool.text: If \( \dfrac{4x+1}{x-2} = A + \dfrac{B}{x-2} \) for all \( x \neq 2 \), what is the value of \( A + B \)?
pool.educational_aim: Apply properties and theorems of Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions in multi-step exam problems, including finding unknown parameters, interpreting exact diagrams/graphs, and avoiding common algebraic traps.
pool.exam_archetype: Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: Rewrite numerator: \( 4x + 1 = 4(x - 2) + 9 \). Then \( \dfrac{4(x - 2) + 9}{x - 2} = 4 + \dfrac{9}{x - 2} \). Thus \( A = 4 \) and \( B = 9 \). The sum is \( A + B = 4 + 9 = 13 \).
hints: Rewrite numerator: \( 4x + 1 = 4(x - 2) + 9 \).
The sum is \(A + B = 4 + 9\).
pool.text_ar: إذا كان \(\dfrac{4x+1}{x-2} = A + \dfrac{B}{x-2}\) لكل \(x \neq 2\), ما قيمة \(A + B\)?
pool.sol_ar: أعد كتابة البسط: \(4x + 1 = 4(x - 2) + 9\). ثم \(\dfrac{4(x - 2) + 9}{x - 2} = 4 + \dfrac{9}{x - 2}\). وعليه \(A = 4\) و \(B = 9\). مجموع يساوي \(A + B = 4 + 9 = 13\).

pool.text: In the \( xy \)-plane, the line \( y = -\frac{3}{4}x + 6 \) intersects the \( x \)-axis at point \( P \) and the \( y \)-axis at point \( Q \). What are the coordinates of the midpoint of segment \( PQ \)?
pool.educational_aim: Synthesize One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error with related mathematical concepts to solve high-difficulty past-paper synthesis, optimization, proof, or modeling problems.
pool.exam_archetype: One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: At \( y = 0 \): \( 0 = -\frac{3}{4}x + 6 \Rightarrow \frac{3}{4}x = 6 \Rightarrow x = 8 \), so \( P = (8, 0) \). At \( x = 0 \): \( y = 6 \), so \( Q = (0, 6) \). The midpoint is \( \left(\frac{8 + 0}{2}, \frac{0 + 6}{2}\right) = (4, 3) \).
hints: At \( y = 0 \): \( 0 = -\frac{3}{4}x + 6 \Rightarrow \frac{3}{4}x = 6 \Rightarrow x = 8 \), so \( P = (8, 0) \).
The midpoint is \(\left(\frac{8 + 0}{2}, \frac{0 + 6}{2}\right)\).
pool.text_ar: في \(xy\)-المستوى، مستقيم \(y = -\frac{3}{4}x + 6\) يقطع محور \(x\) عند نقطة \(P\) و محور \(y\) عند نقطة \(Q\). ما الإحداثيات من نقطة المنتصف من قطعة \(PQ\)؟
pool.sol_ar: عند \(y = 0\): \(0 = -\frac{3}{4}x + 6 \Rightarrow \frac{3}{4}x = 6 \Rightarrow x = 8\), so \(P = (8, 0)\). عند \(x = 0\): \(y = 6\), so \(Q = (0, 6)\). نقطة المنتصف يساوي \(\left(\frac{8 + 0}{2}, \frac{0 + 6}{2}\right) = (4, 3)\).

pool.text: If \( x^4 - 13x^2 + 36 = 0 \), what is the product of all real solutions?
pool.educational_aim: Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations: apply core concepts and algebraic reasoning to standard exam items (sat quad 3).
pool.exam_archetype: Ratios, Rates, Proportions, Percentages & Scatterplots — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: Let \( u = x^2 \): \( u^2 - 13u + 36 = 0 \implies (u - 4)(u - 9) = 0 \implies u = 4 \text{ or } u = 9 \). The real solutions are \( x = \pm 2 \) and \( x = \pm 3 \). The product is \( (2)(-2)(3)(-3) = -4 \times -9 = 36 \).

pool.text_ar: إذا كان \(x^4 - 13x^2 + 36 = 0\)، ما حاصل الضرب من جميع حقيقي حلول؟

pool.text: A linear function has \( g(0) = -3 \) and its graph is perpendicular to the line \( y = 4x + 7 \). What is \( g(12) \)?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of Desmos Graphing Calculator Tactics by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on SAT past papers.
pool.exam_archetype: Desmos Graphing Calculator Tactics — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: Slope of the perpendicular line is \( m = -1/4 \). Since \( g(0) = -3 \), \( g(x) = -\dfrac{1}{4}x - 3 \). At \( x = 12 \), \( g(12) = -\dfrac{1}{4}(12) - 3 = -3 - 3 = -6 \).
hints: Slope of the perpendicular line is \( m = -1/4 \).
pool.text_ar: الخطية دالة له \(g(0) = -3\) و له التمثيل البياني يعامد المستقيم \(y = 4x + 7\). ما يساوي \(g(12)\)؟

pool.text: The graph of \( y = (x - 2)^2 - 9 \) intersects the \( x \)-axis at points \( A \) and \( B \). What is the distance \( AB \)?
pool.educational_aim: Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations: apply core concepts and algebraic reasoning to standard exam items (sat quad 2).
pool.exam_archetype: Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions — Multi-Step Application & Parameter Solve
pool.sol: Set \( y = 0 \): \( (x - 2)^2 = 9 \implies x - 2 = \pm 3 \implies x = 5 \text{ or } x = -1 \). Distance \( AB = 5 - (-1) = 6 \).
hints: Set \( y = 0 \): \( (x - 2)^2 = 9 \implies x - 2 = \pm 3 \implies x = 5 \text{ or } x = -1 \).
Distance: \(AB\). Rewrite and substitute: \(AB = 5 - (-1)\).
Verify your final answer by substituting back into the original relationship.
pool.text_ar: التمثيل البياني لـ \(y = (x - 2)^2 - 9\) يقطع محور \(x\) عند نقاط \(A\) و \(B\). ما المسافة \(AB\)؟
pool.sol_ar: مجموعة \(y = 0\): \((x - 2)^2 = 9 \implies x - 2 = \pm 3 \implies x = 5 \text{ or } x = -1\). المسافة \(AB = 5 - (-1) = 6\).
hints_ar: تحقق من الخاص بك النهائي الإجابة بواسطة بالتعويض مرة أخرى إلى الأصلية العلاقة.

pool.text: A cyclist travels uphill for 12 miles at an average speed of 8 mph, and then returns downhill along the same 12-mile route at an average speed of 24 mph. What is the average speed, in mph, for the entire round trip?

pool.text: If \( x - 2 \) is a factor of \( P(x) = x^3 + kx^2 - 4x + 12 \), what is the value of \( k \)?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on SAT past papers.
pool.exam_archetype: One-Variable Statistics, Distributions & Margin of Error — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol: By the Factor Theorem, \( P(2) = 0 \): \( 2^3 + k(2^2) - 4(2) + 12 = 0 \implies 8 + 4k - 8 + 12 = 0 \implies 4k + 12 = 0 \implies k = -3 \).
hints: Simplify the relation to: \(8 + 4k - 8 + 12 = 0\).
Solve \(4k + 12 = 0\) to determine \(k\).
pool.text_ar: إذا كان \(x - 2\) يساوي a حلّل من \(P(x) = x^3 + kx^2 - 4x + 12\), ما قيمة \(k\)?
pool.sol_ar: بواسطة حلّل نظرية, \(P(2) = 0\): \(2^3 + k(2^2) - 4(2) + 12 = 0 \implies 8 + 4k - 8 + 12 = 0 \implies 4k + 12 = 0 \implies k = -3\).

pool.sol: Multiply by \( x - 3 \): \( x = 3 + 4(x - 3) \implies x = 4x - 9 \implies 3x = 9 \implies x = 3 \). However, substituting \( x = 3 \) makes the denominator zero. Therefore \( x = 3 \) is extraneous and there is no real solution.

pool.text: In a scatterplot, the actual value of \( y \) for \( x = 5 \) is 42. If the line of best fit is \( \hat{y} = 4.2x + 18 \), what is the value of the residual for this data point?
pool.educational_aim: Apply core Ratios, Rates, Proportions, Percentages & Scatterplots principles to solve foundational problems accurately.
pool.exam_archetype: Ratios, Rates, Proportions, Percentages & Scatterplots — Core Procedural Application
pool.sol: The residual is defined as \( \text{Actual } y - \text{Predicted } \hat{y} \). First find the predicted value: \( \hat{y} = 4.2(5) + 18 = 21 + 18 = 39 \). The residual is \( 42 - 39 = 3 \).
hints: The residual is defined as \( \text{Actual } y - \text{Predicted } \hat{y} \).
First find the predicted value: \(\hat{y} = 4.2(5) + 18 = 21 + 18\).
The residual is \(42 - 39\).
pool.text_ar: في مخطط الانتشار، فعلي قيمة من \(y\) لـ \(x = 5\) يساوي 42. إذا كان خط أفضل مطابقة يساوي \(\hat{y} = 4.2x + 18\)، ما قيمة البواقي لـ هذا بيانات نقطة؟
pool.sol_ar: البواقي يساوي معرّفة كـ \(\text{Actual } y - \text{Predicted } \hat{y}\). الأول أوجد المتنبأ به قيمة: \(\hat{y} = 4.2(5) + 18 = 21 + 18 = 39\). البواقي يساوي \(42 - 39 = 3\).

pool.text: For what value of \( b \) does the line \( y = 3x + b \) pass through the intersection point of \( y = 2x + 1 \) and \( y = -x + 10 \)?

pool.sol: Find intersection: \( 2x + 1 = -x + 10 \implies 3x = 9 \implies x = 3 \). Then \( y = 2(3) + 1 = 7 \). Substitute \( (3, 7) \) into \( y = 3x + b \implies 7 = 3(3) + b \implies b = -2 \).

pool.sol_ar: أوجد تقاطع: \(2x + 1 = -x + 10 \implies 3x = 9 \implies x = 3\). ثم \(y = 2(3) + 1 = 7\). عوّض \((3, 7)\) إلى \(y = 3x + b \implies 7 = 3(3) + b \implies b = -2\).

pool.text: Line \( p \) has equation \( 3x - 4y = 12 \). Line \( q \) is parallel to line \( p \) and passes through the point \( (8, 1) \). What is the \( x \)-intercept of line \( q \)?
pool.educational_aim: Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities: apply determining slopes, intercepts, and linear equations across multi-step problems (sat linfun 3).
pool.exam_archetype: Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Rewrite line \( p \) in slope-intercept form: \( -4y = -3x + 12 \implies y = \dfrac{3}{4}x - 3 \), so its slope is \( \dfrac{3}{4} \). Since line \( q \) is parallel, its equation through \( (8, 1) \) is: \( y - 1 = \dfrac{3}{4}(x - 8) \implies y - 1 = \dfrac{3}{4}x - 6 \implies y = \dfrac{3}{4}x - 5 \). To find the \( x \)-intercept, set \( y = 0 \): \( \dfrac{3}{4}x - 5 = 0 \implies \dfrac{3}{4}x = 5 \implies x = \dfrac{20}{3} \approx 6.67 \). (Accept 20/3 or 6.67).
hints: Concept & Formula (Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(p\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \(p\) and \(3x - 4y = 12\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Linear Functions & Linear Inequalities and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(p\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(p\) و \(3x - 4y = 12\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الخطية الدوال & الخطية المتباينات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: مستقيم \(p\) له معادلة \(3x - 4y = 12\). مستقيم \(q\) يساوي موازٍ لـ مستقيم \(p\) و يمر بالنقطة \((8, 1)\). ما المقطع على محور \(x\) من مستقيم \(q\)؟
pool.sol_ar: أعد كتابة مستقيم \(p\) في ميل-مقطع الصيغة: \(-4y = -3x + 12 \implies y = \dfrac{3}{4}x - 3\)، لذلك له ميل يساوي \(\dfrac{3}{4}\). بما أن مستقيم \(q\) يساوي الموازي، له معادلة خلال \((8, 1)\) يساوي: \(y - 1 = \dfrac{3}{4}(x - 8) \implies y - 1 = \dfrac{3}{4}x - 6 \implies y = \dfrac{3}{4}x - 5\). إلى أوجد المقطع على محور \(x\)، مجموعة \(y = 0\): \(\dfrac{3}{4}x - 5 = 0 \implies \dfrac{3}{4}x = 5 \implies x = \dfrac{20}{3} \approx 6.67\). (Accept 20/3 أو 6.67).

pool.text: A system of two linear equations has no solutions. One equation is \( y = -\dfrac{3}{4}x + 2 \). Which could be the other equation?
pool.educational_aim: Synthesize Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations with related mathematical concepts to solve high-difficulty past-paper synthesis, optimization, proof, or modeling problems.
pool.exam_archetype: Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Rewrite \( 3x + 4y = 12 \implies 4y = -3x + 12 \implies y = -\dfrac{3}{4}x + 3 \). This line has the same slope \( -3/4 \) and a different y-intercept (3 vs 2), meaning they are parallel and have no solution. Choice D has \( y = -\dfrac{3}{4}x + 2 \), which is the exact same line (infinitely many solutions).
hints: Concept & Formula (Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(y = -\dfrac{3}{4}x + 2\) to the requested unknown.

Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(y = -\dfrac{3}{4}x + 2\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: أعد كتابة \(y = -\dfrac{3}{4}x + 2\) بالصورة الجبرية القياسية واعزل المقدار المجهول في طرف مستقل.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: نظام من اثنان الخطية معادلات له لا حلول. واحد معادلة يساوي \(y = -\dfrac{3}{4}x + 2\). التي يمكن be آخر معادلة؟
pool.sol_ar: أعد كتابة \(3x + 4y = 12 \implies 4y = -3x + 12 \implies y = -\dfrac{3}{4}x + 3\). هذا مستقيم له نفس ميل \(-3/4\) و مختلف المقطع الصادي (3 vs 2)، meaning هم تكون الموازي و لدينا لا يوجد حل. الخيار D له \(y = -\dfrac{3}{4}x + 2\)، التي يساوي دقيق نفس مستقيم (عدد لا نهائي من الحلول).

pool.text: A data set \( X \) has mean \( \mu \) and standard deviation \( \sigma \). A new data set \( Y \) is formed by the transformation \( y_i = 3x_i - 5 \) for each value in \( X \). What are the mean and standard deviation of \( Y \)?

pool.sol: Linear transformation properties: \( E(3X - 5) = 3\mu - 5 \). The constant \( -5 \) does not affect spread, while multiplication by 3 scales standard deviation: \( \text{SD}(3X - 5) = |3|\sigma = 3\sigma \).
hints: Linear transformation properties: \( E(3X - 5) = 3\mu - 5 \).
The constant \( -5 \) does not affect spread, while multiplication by 3 scales standard deviation: \(\text{SD}(3X - 5)\). Rewrite and substitute: \(\text{SD}(3X - 5) = |3|\sigma\).
Confirm that probabilities lie in \([0, 1]\) and simplify any fraction or decimal to match the required precision.
pool.text_ar: بيانات مجموعة \(X\) له المتوسط الحسابي \(\mu\) و الانحراف المعياري \(\sigma\). جديد بيانات مجموعة \(Y\) يساوي formed بواسطة تحويل \(y_i = 3x_i - 5\) لكل قيمة في \(X\). ما المتوسط الحسابي و الانحراف المعياري من \(Y\)؟
pool.sol_ar: تحويل خطي الخصائص: \(E(3X - 5) = 3\mu - 5\). ثابت \(-5\) هل ليس يؤثر على spread، بينما الضرب بواسطة 3 مقاييس الانحراف المعياري: \(\text{SD}(3X - 5) = |3|\sigma = 3\sigma\).

pool.text: Line \( k \) passes through \( (1, -1) \) and \( (3, 3) \). Line \( p \) is perpendicular to line \( k \) and passes through the point \( (8, 3) \). At what point do lines \( k \) and \( p \) intersect?

pool.exam_archetype: Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Slope of \( k \) is \( \frac{3 - (-1)}{3 - 1} = \frac{4}{2} = 2 \). Equation of \( k \): \( y - 3 = 2(x - 3) \Rightarrow y = 2x - 3 \). Line \( p \) has slope \( -\frac{1}{2} \) and passes through \( (8, 3) \): \( y - 3 = -\frac{1}{2}(x - 8) \Rightarrow y = -\frac{1}{2}x + 7 \). Setting them equal: \( 2x - 3 = -\frac{1}{2}x + 7 \Rightarrow \frac{5}{2}x = 10 \Rightarrow x = 4 \). Then \( y = 2(4) - 3 = 5 \). The intersection is \( (4, 5) \).

pool.text: What is the sum of the solutions to \( (x^2 - 3x)^2 - 2(x^2 - 3x) - 8 = 0 \)?
pool.educational_aim: Apply core Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations principles to solve foundational problems accurately.
pool.exam_archetype: Equivalent Expressions & Quadratic Equations — Core Procedural Application
pool.sol: Let \( u = x^2 - 3x \): \( u^2 - 2u - 8 = 0 \implies (u - 4)(u + 2) = 0 \implies u = 4 \text{ or } u = -2 \). Case 1: \( x^2 - 3x = 4 \implies x^2 - 3x - 4 = 0 \) has discriminant \( 9 + 16 = 25 > 0 \) (2 real roots with sum 3). Case 2: \( x^2 - 3x = -2 \implies x^2 - 3x + 2 = 0 \) has discriminant \( 9 - 8 = 1 > 0 \) (2 real roots with sum 3). The sum of all 4 real solutions is \( 3 + 3 = 6 \).
hints: Let \( u = x^2 - 3x \): \( u^2 - 2u - 8 = 0 \implies (u - 4)(u + 2) = 0 \implies u = 4 \text{ or } u = -2 \).

The sum of all 4 real solutions is \(3 + 3\).
pool.text_ar: ما مجموع من حلول إلى \((x^2 - 3x)^2 - 2(x^2 - 3x) - 8 = 0\)؟

hints_ar: حالة 1: \(x^2 - 3x = 4 \implies x^2 - 3x - 4 = 0\) له المميز \(9 + 16 = 25 > 0\) (2 حقيقي جذور مع مجموع 3). حالة 2: \(x^2 - 3x = -2 \implies x^2 - 3x + 2 = 0\) له المميز \(9 - 8 = 1 > 0\) (2 حقيقي جذور مع مجموع 3).
مجموع من all 4 حقيقي الحلول يساوي \(3 + 3\).

pool.text: If \( \sqrt{2x + 7} = x + 2 \), what is the real solution for \( x \)?
pool.educational_aim: Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Express: apply core concepts and algebraic reasoning to standard exam items (sat expoly 3).
pool.exam_archetype: Probability, Conditional Probability & Two-Way Tables — Non-Routine Synthesis & Past-Paper Challenge
pool.sol: Square both sides: \( 2x + 7 = (x + 2)^2 = x^2 + 4x + 4 \). Rearrange into standard form: \( x^2 + 2x - 3 = 0 \). Factor: \( (x + 3)(x - 1) = 0 \implies x = -3 \) or \( x = 1 \). Check for extraneous solutions: for \( x = -3 \), \( \sqrt{2(-3)+7} = \sqrt{1} = 1 \neq -3 + 2 = -1 \) (extraneous). For \( x = 1 \), \( \sqrt{2(1)+7} = 3 = 1 + 2 = 3 \) (valid). Thus \( x = 1 \).
hints: Concept & Formula (Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(\sqrt{2x + 7} = x + 2\) to the requested unknown.

pool.text_ar: إذا كان \(\sqrt{2x + 7} = x + 2\)، ما حقيقي حل لـ \(x\)؟
pool.sol_ar: المربع كلا الطرفين: \(2x + 7 = (x + 2)^2 = x^2 + 4x + 4\). أعد ترتيب إلى قياسي الصيغة: \(x^2 + 2x - 3 = 0\). حلّل: \((x + 3)(x - 1) = 0 \implies x = -3\) أو \(x = 1\). تحقق لـ دخيل حلول: لـ \(x = -3\)، \(\sqrt{2(-3)+7} = \sqrt{1} = 1 \neq -3 + 2 = -1\) (دخيل). لـ \(x = 1\)، \(\sqrt{2(1)+7} = 3 = 1 + 2 = 3\) (صحيح). وعليه \(x = 1\).

pool.sol: The constant rate of draining is \( m = \frac{15 - 24}{5 - 2} = \frac{-9}{3} = -3 \) thousand gallons per hour. The reservoir is completely empty when \( V(t) = 0 \): \( 0 = -3t + 30 \Rightarrow 3t = 30 \Rightarrow t = 10 \) hours.

pool.text: The line \( x = 5 \) intersects the circle \( (x - 2)^2 + (y + 1)^2 = 25 \) at two points. What is the distance between these two points?

pool.text: In the \( xy \)-plane, the lines \( ax + 5y = 10 \) and \( 3x - 2y = 8 \) are perpendicular, where \( a \) is a constant. What is the value of \( a \)?

pool.text: A bag contains 7 red, 5 green, and 8 blue counters. A counter is drawn and NOT replaced. What is the probability that the first is red and the second is blue?

pool.text: Which quadratic equation has roots \( 3 + 2\sqrt{2} \) and \( 3 - 2\sqrt{2} \)?

pool.text: If \( P(x) = x^3 - 2x^2 - 5x + 6 \) has a root at \( x = 1 \), what are the other two roots?

pool.sol: Divide \( P(x) \) by \( x - 1 \): \( x^3 - 2x^2 - 5x + 6 = (x - 1)(x^2 - x - 6) \). Factor the quadratic: \( x^2 - x - 6 = (x - 3)(x + 2) \). The remaining roots are \( x = 3 \) and \( x = -2 \).
hints: Factor the quadratic: \( x^2 - x - 6 = (x - 3)(x + 2) \).
The remaining roots are \(x = 3\) and \(x\).

pool.sol_ar: اقسم \(P(x)\) بواسطة \(x - 1\): \(x^3 - 2x^2 - 5x + 6 = (x - 1)(x^2 - x - 6)\). حلّل التربيعية: \(x^2 - x - 6 = (x - 3)(x + 2)\). المتبقي جذور تكون \(x = 3\) و \(x = -2\).

pool.text: For what value of \( k \) does the parabola \( y = 2x^2 - 8x + k \) have its vertex on the \( x \)-axis?

pool.sol: The vertex has \( x = -\dfrac{-8}{2(2)} = 2 \). For the vertex to be on the x-axis, \( y = 0 \) at \( x = 2 \): \( 2(2)^2 - 8(2) + k = 0 \implies 8 - 16 + k = 0 \implies k = 8 \).

pool.sol_ar: الرأس له \(x = -\dfrac{-8}{2(2)} = 2\). لـ الرأس إلى be على x-المحور, \(y = 0\) عند \(x = 2\): \(2(2)^2 - 8(2) + k = 0 \implies 8 - 16 + k = 0 \implies k = 8\).

pool.text: A solid metal cylinder has a radius of 2 cm, a height of 5 cm, and a mass of 440 grams. What is the density of the metal in grams per cubic centimeter? (Use \( \pi \approx 3.14 \))

pool.text: In the \( xy \)-plane, the line \( 4x + 3y = 24 \) intersects the \( x \)-axis at point \( A \) and the \( y \)-axis at point \( B \). What is the length of segment \( AB \)?

pool.sol: Setting \( y = 0 \): \( 4x = 24 \Rightarrow x = 6 \), so \( A = (6, 0) \). Setting \( x = 0 \): \( 3y = 24 \Rightarrow y = 8 \), so \( B = (0, 8) \). By the Pythagorean theorem, the distance is \( \sqrt{6^2 + 8^2} = \sqrt{36 + 64} = \sqrt{100} = 10 \).
hints: Setting \( y = 0 \): \( 4x = 24 \Rightarrow x = 6 \), so \( A = (6, 0) \).
Setting \( x = 0 \): \( 3y = 24 \Rightarrow y = 8 \), so \( B = (0, 8) \).
By the Pythagorean theorem, the distance is \(\sqrt{6^2 + 8^2} = \sqrt{36 + 64}\).

pool.sol_ar: بتعيين \(y = 0\): \(4x = 24 \Rightarrow x = 6\)، لذلك \(A = (6, 0)\). بتعيين \(x = 0\): \(3y = 24 \Rightarrow y = 8\)، لذلك \(B = (0, 8)\). بواسطة نظرية فيثاغورس، المسافة يساوي \(\sqrt{6^2 + 8^2} = \sqrt{36 + 64} = \sqrt{100} = 10\).

pool.text: If \( \dfrac{4x + 11}{x^2 - 9} = \dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 3} \) for all \( x \neq \pm 3 \), what is the value of \( A \)?
pool.educational_aim: Apply core Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions principles to solve foundational problems accurately.
pool.exam_archetype: Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions — Core Procedural Application
pool.sol: Multiply both sides by \( x^2 - 9 = (x - 3)(x + 3) \): \( 4x + 11 = A(x + 3) + B(x - 3) \). To solve for \( A \), substitute \( x = 3 \): \( 4(3) + 11 = A(3 + 3) + B(0) \implies 12 + 11 = 6A \implies 23 = 6A \implies A = \dfrac{23}{6} \approx 3.83 \). (Accept 23/6 or 3.83).
hints: Concept & Formula (Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions): anchor your approach on the governing relation connecting \(\dfrac{4x + 11}{x^2 - 9} = \dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 3}\) to the requested unknown.
Equation Setup: combine \(\dfrac{4x + 11}{x^2 - 9} = \dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 3}\) and \(x \neq \pm 3\) into a single simplified equation in the unknown.
Penultimate Step: carry out the final symbolic simplification in Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions and reduce any fraction or radical to simplest exact form.
hints_ar: المفهوم والقانون (الرياضيات): اربط خطة الحل بالعلاقة الرياضية الحاكمة التي تصل \(\dfrac{4x + 11}{x^2 - 9} = \dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 3}\) بالمجهول المطلوب.
تكوين المعادلة: اجمع بين \(\dfrac{4x + 11}{x^2 - 9} = \dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 3}\) و \(x \neq \pm 3\) في معادلة مبسطة واحدة بدلالة المجهول.
الخطوة ما قبل النهائية: نفّذ التبسيط الجبري والعددي في (الرياضيات) واختصر أي كسر أو جذر إلى أبسط صورة دقيقة.
pool.text_ar: إذا كان \(\dfrac{4x + 11}{x^2 - 9} = \dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 3}\) لكل \(x \neq \pm 3\), ما قيمة \(A\)?
pool.sol_ar: اضرب كلا الطرفين بواسطة \(x^2 - 9 = (x - 3)(x + 3)\): \(4x + 11 = A(x + 3) + B(x - 3)\). إلى حل لإيجاد \(A\)، عوّض \(x = 3\): \(4(3) + 11 = A(3 + 3) + B(0) \implies 12 + 11 = 6A \implies 23 = 6A \implies A = \dfrac{23}{6} \approx 3.83\). (Accept 23/6 أو 3.83).

pool.text: The line \( L_1 \) has equation \( 2x - 5y = 10 \). Line \( L_2 \) is the reflection of \( L_1 \) across the line \( y = x \). What is the slope of \( L_2 \)?
